{"metadata":{"description":"Automode for DeepSeek Harness: a fourth permission preset — full access with an LLM classifier as the only gate before every tool call.","id":"gh:1327614239","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-auto-approval","slug":"Andy8647/dsh-auto-approval","topics":["automode","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-auto-approval","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Automode for DeepSeek Harness: a fourth permission preset — full access with an LLM classifier as th"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e only gate before every tool call."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-auto-approval"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **fourth permission preset** for DeepSeek Harness: pick **Automode** in the composer's permission "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"dropdown and the session runs on full access with an LLM classifier as the only gate before every to"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ol call. No approval prompts — the classifier answers for you."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The permission model stays 3 + 1: the three official sandbox levels, plus one auto tier. Selecting a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ny other preset turns the plugin off; there is no second switch."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **0.2.0 is a rewrite of the 0.1.x line.** The on/off switch became a permission preset: install, p"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ick **Automode**, done. Upgrading? See Upgrading from 0.1.x."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The recording: pick **Automode**, send one prompt (create a directory, write a file, read it back, t"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"hen run `echo danger_test`). The agent runs the file steps unattended — the classifier allows them ("},{"id":"p8s3","text":"`L1-deep` / `whitelist`) — and the final command is blocked by a hard rule (`L0-deny`). The chip's d"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ialog shows both verdicts and the cumulative counts."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **L0** — regex deny rules, self-kill guard, trusted-tool and bash-prefix allowlists. Deterministic"},{"id":"p11s2","text":", no model call.
- **L1** — the latest real user message plus the bare tool call go to a classifier."},{"id":"p11s3","text":" Two backends: **`llm`** (default) runs a two-stage prompt on a chat model (fast single-token filter"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" → deep CoT check when flagged); **`jev`** sends one HTTP request to TypeSafe's System One and gets "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"back typed probabilities — the verdict is a threshold comparison, no text parsing. Tool output is ne"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ver shown to the classifier on either backend, so injected content cannot talk it into an allow.
- *"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"*Fail-closed** — a timeout, a parse failure, or a missing model denies the call."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The preset writes the same knobs as `danger-full-access` (full access + approval `never`), so nothin"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"g else asks the user either. What distinguishes the two entries is the plugin's gate — and the offic"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ial preset service keeps the last selected name, so the dropdown shows which one you picked."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> **Just published a new version?** pnpm 11 refuses versions younger than 24 hours (`minimumReleaseA"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ge`, a supply-chain default), so `add dsh-auto-approval` resolves the *previous* release for the fir"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"st day. Install the exact version (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-auto-approval@0.4.0`) or add th"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"e package to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then pick **Automode** in the permission dropdown next to the composer (or `/permission automode`). "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"The first time you do so in a browser, a one-time notice explains the trade-off (the official "Enabl"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"e Full access?" gate is keyed to `danger-full-access` and never fires for a custom preset). The `Aut"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"o` chip then appears beside the preset selector with cumulative allow/deny counts and a click-throug"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ars beside the preset selector with cumulative allow/deny counts and a click-through decision table."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Source install: clone the repo, `pnpm install && pnpm run build`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" clone the repo, `pnpm install && pnpm run build`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add link:/<path>`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Upgrading from 0.1.x"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"0.2.0 keeps the package name, the `auto-approval:` settings section and every config key, so an upgr"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ade needs no config changes. What changed:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| | 0.1.x | 0.2.0 |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Switch | plugin setting `enabled` + a UI switch | the **Automode** permission preset (no second sw"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"itch) |
| Packages | `dsh-auto-approval` + `dsh-client-ui-auto-approval` | `dsh-auto-approval` (host"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" + browser halves in one package) |
| Sandbox | whatever preset was active; DSH's own escalation pro"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"mpt still reached the user | full access + approval `never`; nothing prompts |
| L1 unconfigured | a"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"llowed everything (a rubber stamp) | denies everything outside the allowlists |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"If no classifier is configured (`classifierBackend: jev` or a `classifierFastProvider` / `classifier"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"FastModel` route), automode now fails closed — configure one, or only trusted tools and allowlisted "},{"id":"p23s3","text":" automode now fails closed — configure one, or only trusted tools and allowlisted commands will run."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"0.2.x dropped `settings.yaml` and `ctx.settings.installSection`: a plugin's configuration is simply "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"its own composition entry's `config`, edited in the active profile's patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/profile"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"s/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`) and re-read when the loader re-applies the plugin:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"On 0.1.x the same keys lived under an `auto-approval:` section of `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`; that fi"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"le is imported once into the profile patch on first 0.2.x boot, but only for entries whose fields ar"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"e declared volatile, so a third-party entry like this one has to be moved by hand."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Every key is optional. `denyPatterns` / `autoApproveTools` / `bashCommandPrefixes` **replace** the d"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"efaults wholesale (YAML arrays do not merge), so restate the values you want to keep."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Without a classifier there is no L1, and automode fails closed: only trusted tools and allowlisted c"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ommands run, everything else is denied. That is deliberate — a session with no classifier is not a s"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"afety net, and silently allowing everything would make the gate a rubber stamp."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Jev backend (TypeSafe System One)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"`classifierBackend: jev` replaces the two-stage LLM prompt with a single typed-probability call to J"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ev. Jev does not generate text: one request returns calibrated probabilities for five questions aske"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"d over the same frame (latest user message + tool name + arguments), and the verdict is a threshold "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"comparison in code — the whole text-parsing chain (VERDICT lines, truncation finishes, token budgets"},{"id":"p31s5","text":") disappears. One round trip, ~300 ms."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Tracks the latest official DeepSeek Harness release. Verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.2-rc."},{"id":"p36s2","text":"1** and **0.1.5-rc.2** (install → boot → real tool-call decision in a disposable `DSH_HOME`). Older "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"releases are not supported."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The bundle patch restates the official preset table, so a base release that adds a preset needs this"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"estates the official preset table, so a base release that adds a preset needs this file updated too."}],"truncated":true}
